_comment: Paper-1 params for the four MC-dropout strategies (LeastConfidenceDropout, MarginSamplingDropout, EntropySamplingDropout, BALDDropout) of the re-run part paper1_rerun_b: identical to params_paper1.json plus model_args.dropout_p = 0.5, a dropout layer on the 2048-d pooled features right before the classifier of the DANINHAS ResNet-50, active during training and during the n_drop MC passes, as in DeepAL. Without it these strategies were degenerate (KI-41, .specs/quality/known-issues.md; ADR 0014). Only these four strategies train with this layer, so their round-0 model differs from the other strategies' (inherent to MC dropout). See .specs/experiments/campaign.md.
